facts.business: Bajaj Steel Industries Limited is a diversified engineering enterprise with over 64 years of legacy, manufacturing cotton ginning machinery, infrastructure solutions (PEBs, electrical panels, heavy engineering), and specialised products across 14 manufacturing facilities.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: As of FY26: 14 facilities with over 10 lakh sq. ft. built-up area across five divisions

guidance_or_targets.statement: With improving market conditions, stronger execution capabilities and a robust order pipeline, the company is well positioned for the next phase of growth.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters: Inventory valuation (24.49% of total assets) and Revenue recognition; no qualification or adverse opinion expressed.

key_risks: Delays in order conversion and dispatches
Subdued export demand for Cotton Ginning Machinery
facts.related_party_note: Unsecured loans from related parties: Rs 432.47 lakh (March 31, 2026) and Rs 401.74 lakh (March 31, 2025); Term loan from related party: Rs 2,350.61 lakh (March 31, 2026) and Rs 2,977.61 lakh (March 31, 2025); Current maturity of related party loan: Rs 818.63 lakh (March 31, 2026) and Rs 715.19 lakh (March 31, 2025).
